Title:ESTIMATES OF EXPENDITURE
MPs Speaking:Mr Tan Soo Khoon (Mr Speaker);


Column: 597

[Mr Speaker in the Chair]

ESTIMATES OF EXPENDITURE
(Announcement by Mr Speaker)


    Mr Speaker: In accordance with the provisions of paragraph (7) of Standing Order 89, I have fixed the times for the conclusion of consideration of the heads of expenditure in the Estimates of Expenditure for FY 1992/1993 in the Committee of Supply.

    These times have been notified to hon. Members and will appear in the Official Report (Cols. 723 - 726).
Committee of Supply - ESTIMATES OF EXPENDITURE FOR THE FINANCIAL YEAR 1ST APRIL 1992 TO 31ST MARCH 1993 (Cols. 723 - 726)
